title: Ancient Forms: Handbuilding and Pit Firing
source_quote: Ancient Forms: Handbuilding and Pit Firing Sat, Nov 14, 2026 10:00 AM Sat, Dec 5, 2026 5:00 PM
summary: Two-part earthenware class: Nov 14-15 handbuilding workshop, then Dec 5 all-day pit firing ceremony at Wildling Collaborative Arts. Students can use commercial or wild clay. Registration open.
evidence_sentence: The second weekend features an all-day pit firing ceremony at Wildling, with weather backup date Dec 6, including beeswaxing to seal pieces for food use.
evidence_quote: The first Saturday of December (or Sunday**) is our all-day pit firing ceremony at Wildling, from 9am – 4pm.
how_to_join: Register through Wildling Collaborative Arts website
cost_text: $235 includes studio instruction, commercial clay, firing and sealing
commitment: Sat & Sun Nov 14-15, then all-day Dec 5 (or Dec 6 backup)
